name: Replicate
description: Run open models and community fine-tunes behind one API.
overview: Replicate hosts thousands of open models and community fine-tunes, including language, image and audio models. New accounts get a small starter credit; API data is deleted after one hour by default, though community models define their own handling.
free_access: Hundreds of open and community models
API data deleted after one hour by default
notes: Community models can have their own retention behaviour.
